exposure: women with known unrepaired hernia developed prior to pregnancy
women with hernia developed during pregnancy
known unrepaired hernia prior to pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women with hernias treated at the Hong Kong West Cluster between January 2002 and January 2022
finding: Conservative management of hernias in pregnant women is safe, with no hernia complications during pregnancy and a high rate of spontaneous hernia disappearance after delivery, particularly for inguinal hernias.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 22% of the participants.
